title: Record that a release went out
statement: As a developer, I can record that a release went out, and at which commit, so "what shipped" has an answer that a person stated.
overview: Proposed addition: Trevor's direction does not name a lifecycle, and the rest of this feature can be built without one. It differs from `plan deliver`, which refuses until all is done, because a release checklist has steps that only happen afterwards, such as turning something back on.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only an explicit command marks a release released, and it records when and the commit.
Unchecked steps do not refuse it; the command lists them, and they can still be checked afterwards.
Reading a released version's stories as they stood uses Git at that commit, and the release stores no copy of them.
